results.name: Tracing is a third section after Process: with no run it says so and sends the person to the Process page
A run started on the Process page (in another tab) shows up here by itself, live, within seconds

Header numbers: duration, cost, tokens, calls and errors count up while the run goes; the heading shows the goal
The axis follows the run: round ticks starting at 0s, never more than five, and it moves up as the run gets longer

Details: a click opens a window with the span's numbers and input; Esc closes it and puts focus back on the row
Keyboard: one row is in the tab order; arrows, Home and End move between rows; Left folds and shows +N, Right opens again
Fold finished closes finished blocks to one line each; Expand all opens them again; clicking a chevron folds one block
The performance cards read the same trace: where the time went, the critical path and the engines; a row opens that span
After the person approves on the Process page, the waiting span closes with the time it took, and the failed try of the tester stays as its own failed span
When every block is finished the state turns Done, the clock stops and the numbers settle
